description: ClawFS design specification. Defines storage layout, encryption format, vector dimensions, and POSIX interface. All components must conform to this spec.

encryption.note: Each file gets a unique random nonce stored alongside ciphertext. Key never touches disk.

vector_index.note: Vector dimension FROZEN at 1536 (OpenAI ada-002 / NEAR AI default). Use 3072 for text-embedding-3-large. Both valid — choose ONE per deployment and never mix.

vault.purpose: Immutable store for SHA256-signed P1 frozen spec artifacts
vault.note: Once a spec is frozen, it cannot be overwritten. Only Security Agent can add new entries.

migration.strategy: Export pgvector embeddings → re-index into usearch HNSW. FTS5 re-index from raw text.
